summary.text: Pylian whom Nestor arrayed beside mighty Pelagon, Alastor, lord Haemon, and Bias shepherd of the host — likely the same Chromius whom Chloris bore to Neleus with Nestor and Periclymenus, and distinct from the Trojan Chromius figures.

story.text: When Poseidon roused the Achaeans, Agamemnon found Nestor the clear-voiced orator arraying his comrades around mighty Pelagon and Alastor and Chromius and lord Haemon and Bias, shepherd of the host — charioteers first, then footmen to be a bulwark of battle.
